steps.headline: 1. Choose Off, Basic, or AI naming in Assistant settings.
steps.changed: Basic starts selected, as you chose. It keeps a short name from the first message without AI. Off keeps current names and stops automatic naming.
steps.notice: Names you choose yourself stay unchanged in every mode. This is a UI preview with simulated saves, not the implemented naming service.
steps.risk: The extra section makes General settings longer.

steps.path: Assistant settings → General → Session naming → AI
steps.headline: 2. AI naming has its own model choice.
steps.changed: Use the conversation model or choose a separate naming model. The information button explains recurring reviews and provider usage.
steps.notice: The planned schedule is after replies 1 and 3, then every 25 completed replies. A review keeps the name when it still fits.
steps.risk: AI naming sends conversation excerpts to the chosen provider and can use plan allowance or incur charges. Generation is not connected in this preview.

steps.path: Right-click a session in the top strip
steps.headline: 3. Rename a session from its menu.
steps.changed: A Rename session action appears above Move to new window.
steps.notice: You can give an active session a name without asking the assistant. Saved-session and phone entry points are not included in this first preview.
steps.risk: The current preview entry point is the desktop session menu only.

steps.headline: 4. Saving a name protects it from automatic changes.
steps.changed: Edit the name and choose Save name. Saving unchanged text also makes it your chosen name; blank names cannot be saved.
steps.notice: Reopening a manually named session offers Use automatic name to remove that override. This does not change the global naming mode.
steps.risk: Only simulated local state changes in this preview. Durable saves, in-flight protection, and sync are still to be implemented.
